episodeTitle.en: How Netflix builds a culture of excellence | Elizabeth Stone (CTO)
episodeTitle.zh: Netflix如何构建卓越文化 | 伊丽莎白·斯通（CTO）

guestBioOfficial.en: Elizabeth Stone is the chief technology officer of Netflix. She previously served as vice president of product data science and engineering, and as vice president of data and insights, at Netflix. Before Netflix, Elizabeth was vice president of science at Lyft, chief operating officer at Nuna, a trader at Merrill Lynch, and an economist at Analysis Group. In our conversation, we discuss: • Elizabeth’s advice for career advancement
guestBioOfficial.zh: 伊丽莎白·斯通（Elizabeth Stone）是Netflix的首席技术官。她此前曾在Netflix担任产品数据科学与工程副总裁，以及数据与洞察副总裁。在加入Netflix之前，伊丽莎白曾担任Lyft的科学副总裁、Nuna的首席运营官，以及美林证券的交易员和Analysis Group的经济学家。在我们的对话中，我们讨论了：• 伊丽莎白对职业发展的建议

title.en: How Netflix builds a culture of excellence | Elizabeth Stone (CTO)
title.zh: Netflix如何构建卓越文化 | 伊丽莎白·斯通（CTO）

summary.en: Elizabeth explains how her economics background shaped her career and why she expects more economists to rise in tech leadership, and shares her 'secret sauce' for consistently climbing quickly across companies. She walks through Netflix's distinctive culture of high talent density, radical candor, and freedom and responsibility, and how that culture is the foundation everything else rests on. The conversation also covers how Netflix structures its data and user-research teams, and what endurance sports like triathlons have taught her about work and life.
summary.zh: Elizabeth 解释了经济学背景如何塑造了她的职业生涯，以及为何她预计会有更多经济学家进入科技公司的领导层，并分享了她能在多家公司快速晋升的“秘诀”。她梳理了 Netflix 以高人才密度、极致坦诚、自由与责任为核心的特殊文化，以及为何这种文化是其他一切的根基。对话还涵盖了 Netflix 如何组织其数据与用户研究团队，以及铁人三项等耐力运动教会她的关于工作与人生的道理。
